episodes.title: Part One
episodes.summary: Virginia and Tony go on with their normal Manhattan lives while Relish the Troll wreaks havoc in Snow White's kingdom. Tony and Virginia land in the 4th kingdom and start their 10 kingdoms-encompassing fantastical journey.

episodes.title: Part Two
episodes.summary: Wolf, realizing his love for Virginia, decides to free her from the Trolls who have abducted her. Tony, too, must figure out a plan to escape prison.

episodes.title: Part Three
episodes.summary: Virginia has been captured again and Tony and Wolf need to find a magic axe that will break a curse on her. Magic birds also help them to find the Hunstman and Acorn the Dwarf. However, they need to leave for Little Lamb Village looking for the mirror.

episodes.title: Part Four
episodes.summary: In Kissing Town, everyone gambles so that they can buy back the Mirror. Wolf wins big but spends the winnings on useless presents for Virginia, and the Huntsman finally outbids him. Wolf then tries to come up with a plan to save the Prince.

episodes.title: Part Five
episodes.summary: Virginia and Tony are captured and the Evil Queen plans to kill all the guests. But right then, Queen Cinderella arrives and decides to question the fake Wendell. Can she save the day?
